# Evaluation across versions (generated by `python -m src.eval.compare`; do not edit by hand)

Same LLM (DeepSeek flash) and same cases for every row. Format: hits/n (percent, 95% Wilson interval). Real = 79 cases from public rulings (66 are disputes, so this is a stress test on contested goods). Synthetic = 60 cases written by Claude, labels unverified. The intervals are wide: differences of a few cases are noise.

## Real cases (70 with an 8-digit answer)

| Version | What changed | Heading (4-digit) top-1 | Exact 8-digit line top-1 | Right 8-digit line in top 3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v0 | first run: search only, no heading hints | 41/79 (52%, 41-63) | 29/70 (41%, 31-53) | 35/70 (50%, 39-61) |
| v1 | + the LLM proposes 4-digit headings; the exact Pakistan lines under them join the pool | 55/79 (70%, 59-79) | 38/70 (54%, 43-65) | 54/70 (77%, 66-85) |
| v2 | + refuses misdeclaration and non-import questions; 'one product' fix | 55/79 (70%, 59-79) | 37/70 (53%, 41-64) | 49/70 (70%, 58-79) |
| v3 | + 131 Classification Committee precedents (each case's own notice and its repeats removed) | 53/79 (67%, 56-76) | 36/70 (51%, 40-63) | 48/70 (69%, 57-78) |
| v3a | v3 with a simulated importer who answers the agent's classification questions from the description only | 50/79 (63%, 52-73) | 32/70 (46%, 35-57) | 48/70 (69%, 57-78) |
| v4 | v3 + reasoning (thinking) switched on for the Classify step only | 54/79 (68%, 57-78) | 38/70 (54%, 43-65) | 51/70 (73%, 61-82) |
| baseline | plain LLM | 52/79 (66%, 55-75) | 18/70 (26%, 17-37) | 24/70 (34%, 24-46) |
| baseline | LLM + search | 41/79 (52%, 41-63) | 24/70 (34%, 24-46) | 30/70 (43%, 32-55) |
| baseline | TariffAI (6-digit) | 39/79 (49%, 39-60) | not possible | not possible |
